info.title: Career Pivot Coach API
info.description: AI-powered backend that helps users pivot into a new role: resume intake, job-description analysis, skill-gap reports, learning plans, portfolio projects, mock interviews, progress tracking and application analytics. Authenticate via `POST /api/auth/login`, then click **Authorize** and paste the access token.

AdaptationOut.title: AdaptationOut
AdaptationOut.description: What the closed loop did after new evidence arrived (interview, assessment or task update).

job_description_ids.title: Job Description Ids
job_description_ids.description: Defaults to all of your saved job descriptions

skills_highlighted.title: Skills Highlighted
skills_highlighted.description: Skills you emphasised; defaults to your skills matching the linked JD

posting_url.title: Posting Url
posting_url.description: Link to the posting (stored, never fetched)

role_family.title: Role Family
role_family.description: Defaults to a family derived from role_title

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: How you applied; the tracker compares channels

resume_version.title: Resume Version
resume_version.description: Label of the resume you sent, e.g. 'v2-analytics'

reached_interview.title: Reached Interview
reached_interview.description: Set true if you were interviewed before a rejection

consistency_rate.title: Consistency Rate
consistency_rate.description: Share of elapsed plan weeks with >=1 completed task

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Shape of every non-validation error returned by the API.

question_ids.title: Question Ids
question_ids.description: Defaults to all answered, unevaluated questions

levels.title: Levels
levels.description: 1-5 level of each score, per the rubric bands

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: criterion -> quote from the answer behind the score

analysis_id.title: Analysis Id
analysis_id.description: Defaults to your latest skill-gap analysis

focus_skills.title: Focus Skills
focus_skills.description: Defaults to your priority skill gaps

adaptation.description: Set on /evaluate: what the closed loop did with these scores

JobCreate.title: JobCreate
JobCreate.description: Provide pasted `text`, a `source_url`, or (manual entry) a list of `required_skills`.

fallback_reason.title: Fallback Reason
fallback_reason.description: Why live data was not used (no key, API error, no results)

target_role.title: Target Role
target_role.description: Defaults to your profile target role

country.title: Country
country.description: ISO country code for live job boards

refresh.title: Refresh
refresh.description: Ignore the cache and call the job board again

source.title: Source
source.description: 'seed' skips live job boards and uses the built-in sample postings (reproducible demos and tests)

needs_review.title: Needs Review
needs_review.description: True if some resume-extracted skills are not yet confirmed by the user

ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate
ProfileUpdate.description:
All fields optional; only provided fields are changed.

`skills`, when provided, REPLACES the user's skill list and marks every skill as confirmed
(this is how users review/correct what the resume parser extracted).

key_points.title: Key Points
key_points.description: Hidden until the question is evaluated

reason.title: Reason
reason.default: Adjusting plan based on recent progress

analysis_id.title: Analysis Id
analysis_id.description: Defaults to your latest skill-gap analysis

ResourceOut.title: ResourceOut
ResourceOut.description: A link from the curated list (data/resources.json), or a labelled search link when a skill has none.

job_count.title: Job Count
job_count.description: Number of job postings this report is based on
